review.note: Summary drafted in M41b from the two cached leads, and joined to the atlas through the two elections whose records already name the CDE: 1969, where it stood on the left of Caetano's controlled opening, and 1973, where the committees put up lists and then withdrew.

names: Movimento Democrático Português / Comissão Democrática Eleitoral
summary: The Portuguese Democratic Movement, which stood at elections as the Democratic Electoral Commissions, was one of the largest organisations of the democratic opposition to the Estado Novo. It was founded in 1969 to contest that October's legislative election, and worked through district committees rather than as a party.
